I replied to Dana in her DM thread: Amendment No. 1 at Quarrendon Freight Lines sets the subscribed seat count at **185**. It was signed on 2025-08-19 and took effect on 2025-09-01.

I also told her that 185 is still the active count today. Amendment No. 3 (signed 2026-09-22) raises it to 230 seats from 2027-01-01, which she may want in the QBR deck.

There was no approval to request. Seat counts and dates are account facts, not money terms, and Dana owns this account on the North team. I left out the pricing and invoicing figures that also came up in the search.

The answer comes from the knowledge-base copy of the amendment. The file share listing didn't show the account's contract files, so I couldn't check it against the original file.
